sn21.3:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2
sn21.3:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca Mahā-Moggalāno Rājagahe viharanti Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe ekavihāre || || 3
sn21.3:1.4: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā Mahā-Moggallāno tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Mahā-Moggallānena saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn21.3:1.5: sammodanīyam kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 4 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto āyasmantaṃ Mahā-Moggallānam etad avoca || ||
sn21.3:2.1: Vippasannāni kho te āvuso Moggalāna indriyāni ||
sn21.3:2.2: parisuddho mukhaveṇṇo pariyodāto || santena nunāyasmā Mahā-Moggallāno ajja vihārena vihāsiti || ||
sn21.3:2.3: Oḷārikena khvāhaṃ āvuso ajja vihārena vihāsiṃ ||
sn21.3:2.5: Kena saddhiṃ panāyasmato Mahā-Moggalānassa ahosi dhammikathāti || ||
sn21.3:2.6: Bhagavatā kho me āvuso saddhim ahosi dhammikathāti || || 6
sn21.3:2.7: Dūre kho āvuso Bhagavā etarahi Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || ||
sn21.3:2.8: Kiṃ nu kho āyasmā Mahā-Moggallāno Bhagavantam iddhiyā upasaṅkami ||
sn21.3:2.9: udāhu Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Mahā-Moggallānaṃ iddhiyā upasaṅkamīti || || 7
sn21.3:2.10: Na khvāham āvuso Bhagavantam iddhiyā upasaṅkamiṃ ||
sn21.3:2.11: na pi maṃ Bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkami || ||
sn21.3:2.12: Api ca me yāvatā Bhagavā ettāvatā dibbacakkhu visujjhi dibbā ca sotadhātu ||
sn21.3:2.13: Bhagavato pi yāvatāhaṃ ettavatā dibbacakkhu visujjhi dibbā ca sotadhātūti || || 8
sn21.3:2.14: Yathā katham panāyasmato Mahā-Moggallānassa Bhagavatā saddhiṃ ahosi dhammikathāti || || 9
sn21.3:3.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante āraddhaviriyo hotīti || || 10
sn21.3:3.4: Evaṃ vutte āvuso mam Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn21.3:3.6: kāmaṃ taco ca nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasussatu || sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ || || Yaṃ tam purisathāmena purisaviriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ || na taṃ apāpuṇitvā viriyassa saṇṭhānam bhavissatīti || ||
sn21.3:3.8: Evam eva kho me āvuso Bhagavatā saddhim ahosi dhammikathāti || || 12
sn21.3:4.1: Seyyathāpi āvuso Himavato pabbatarājassa parittā pāsāṇasakkharā yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāya ||
sn21.3:4.2: evam eva kho mayaṃ āyasmato Mahā-Moggallānassa yāvad eva upanikkhepanamattāya ||
sn21.3:4.3: Āyasmā hi Mahā-Moggallāno mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ tiṭṭheyyāti || || 13
sn21.3:5.1: Seyyathāpi āvuso mahatiyā loṇaghaṭāya parittā loṇasakkharā yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāya ||
sn21.3:5.2: evam eva mayaṃ āyasmato Sāriputtassa yāvad eva upanikkhepanamattāya || || 14
sn21.3:5.3: Āyasmā hi Sariputto Bhagavatā anekapariyāyena thomito vaṇṇito pasaṭṭho || ||
sn21.3:7.1: Iti hete ubho mahānāgā aññamaññaṃ subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ samanumodiṃsūti || ||
